hash_rules.files: SHA-256 of the complete raw file bytes

hash_rules.self_reference: This lock and tests/test_information_sufficiency_locks.py are intentionally not hashed by this lock.

value.projection: The complete instrument and custodian L1 record envelopes, including signatures, are returned unchanged.
value.equivalence: Both projected observations must deeply equal the same baseline records, not merely share a digest.

value.mapping_domain: Exactly the distinct sample_id values from the custodian samples, with no missing or extra key.
value.source_labels: Every parent-source label is a nonempty string.
value.visible_binding: The custodian study_id equals the instrument study_id; pair IDs match one-to-one and sample IDs are distinct.
witnesses: one distinct parent culture per sample
one shared culture for all samples
value.reality_claim: Synthetic possible assignments only; neither is asserted as actual laboratory history.

value.statement: Each recorded measurement pair has a distinct biological parent source.
value.test: Parent-source labels for the recorded samples are pairwise distinct.
value.authority_limit: No L2 qualification, current-use binding, or execution authorization. The L1 Gate authenticates record binding separately.
